reaction.comment: My usual drive felt longer while the closure was up — tight mornings got tighter.
Life on the corridor shifts when a stretch closes, even briefly — folks notice the detour traffic on side streets.

Toronto Fire Services' published mandate (toronto.ca, retrieved 2026-08-01) prioritizes protection against loss of life, property and the environment. Read against that mandate, this run computed: Response access (free-flow estimate): worst of 2 fire stations +29.1 s added response-route time (Fire Station 232 (1550 Midland Ave): +10.2 s; Fire Station 234 (40 Coronation Dr): +29.1 s) (estimated added response-route time; free-flow routing, not a dispatch model).

mandate.mission: Fire Services provides Toronto residents, visitors and businesses with protection against loss of life, property and the environment from the effects of fire, illness, accidents and all other hazards through preparedness, prevention, public education and emergency response, with an emphasis on quality services, efficiency, effectiveness and safety.
